source: WRDS (CRSP CIZ v2, Compustat, Fama-French) and the Kenneth French data library

sp500_membership.sql: SELECT permno, indno, indfam, mbrstartdt, mbrenddt, mbrflg FROM crsp.dsp500list_v2 ORDER BY permno, mbrstartdt

crsp_monthly.sql: SELECT permno, permco, ticker, issuernm, siccd, primaryexch, sharetype, securitytype, securitysubtype, mthcaldt, mthprc, mthprcflg, mthcap, mthret, mthretx, mthretflg, mthdelflg, mthvol, shrout, mthcumfacpr, mthcumfacshr FROM crsp.msf_v2 WHERE permno IN (SELECT DISTINCT permno FROM crsp.dsp500list_v2 WHERE mbrenddt >= DATE '1974-01-01') AND mthcaldt BETWEEN DATE '1974-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' ORDER BY permno, mthcaldt

crsp_stocknames.sql: SELECT permno, permco, namedt, nameenddt, securitybegdt, securityenddt, hdrcusip, cusip, ticker, issuernm, primaryexch, shareclass, sharetype, securitytype, securitysubtype, siccd FROM crsp.stocknames_v2 WHERE permno IN (SELECT DISTINCT permno FROM crsp.dsp500list_v2 WHERE mbrenddt >= DATE '1974-01-01') ORDER BY permno, namedt

ccm_link.sql: SELECT gvkey, lpermno AS permno, lpermco AS permco, linktype, linkprim, liid, linkdt, linkenddt FROM crsp.ccmxpf_lnkhist WHERE lpermno IN (SELECT DISTINCT permno FROM crsp.dsp500list_v2 WHERE mbrenddt >= DATE '1974-01-01') AND linktype IN ('LC', 'LU', 'LS') AND linkprim IN ('P', 'C', 'J') ORDER BY permno, linkdt

comp_gics_history.sql: SELECT gvkey, indtype, gsector, ggroup, gind, gsubind, indfrom, indthru FROM comp.co_hgic WHERE gvkey IN (SELECT DISTINCT gvkey FROM crsp.ccmxpf_lnkhist WHERE lpermno IN (SELECT DISTINCT permno FROM crsp.dsp500list_v2 WHERE mbrenddt >= DATE '1974-01-01') AND linktype IN ('LC', 'LU', 'LS') AND linkprim IN ('P', 'C', 'J')) ORDER BY gvkey, indfrom

comp_company.sql: SELECT gvkey, conm, sic, naics, gsector, ggroup, gind, gsubind, ipodate, dldte, dlrsn FROM comp.company WHERE gvkey IN (SELECT DISTINCT gvkey FROM crsp.ccmxpf_lnkhist WHERE lpermno IN (SELECT DISTINCT permno FROM crsp.dsp500list_v2 WHERE mbrenddt >= DATE '1974-01-01') AND linktype IN ('LC', 'LU', 'LS') AND linkprim IN ('P', 'C', 'J')) ORDER BY gvkey

comp_funda.sql: SELECT gvkey, datadate, fyear, fyr, curcd, sich, seq, ceq, pstk, pstkrv, pstkl, txditc, at, lt, csho, prcc_f, revt, cogs, xsga, xint, ib, ni, oancf FROM comp.funda WHERE gvkey IN (SELECT DISTINCT gvkey FROM crsp.ccmxpf_lnkhist WHERE lpermno IN (SELECT DISTINCT permno FROM crsp.dsp500list_v2 WHERE mbrenddt >= DATE '1974-01-01') AND linktype IN ('LC', 'LU', 'LS') AND linkprim IN ('P', 'C', 'J')) AND indfmt = 'INDL' AND datafmt = 'STD' AND popsrc = 'D' AND consol = 'C' AND datadate BETWEEN DATE '1970-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' ORDER BY gvkey, datadate

ff5_factors_monthly.sql: SELECT date, mktrf, smb, hml, rmw, cma, rf, umd FROM ff.fivefactors_monthly WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '1974-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' ORDER BY date

ff5_factors_daily.sql: SELECT date, mktrf, smb, hml, rmw, cma, rf, umd FROM ff.fivefactors_daily WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '1974-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' ORDER BY date

sp500_index_daily.sql: SELECT caldt AS date, vwretd, vwretx, ewretd, ewretx, sprtrn, spindx, totval, totcnt FROM crsp.dsp500_v2 WHERE caldt BETWEEN DATE '1974-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' ORDER BY caldt

spy_daily.sql: SELECT permno, dlycaldt AS date, dlyret, dlyretx, dlyprc, ticker FROM crsp.dsf_v2 WHERE permno = 84398 AND dlycaldt <= DATE '2025-12-31' ORDER BY dlycaldt

spmo_daily.sql: SELECT permno, dlycaldt AS date, dlyret, dlyretx, dlyprc, ticker FROM crsp.dsf_v2 WHERE permno = 15725 AND dlycaldt <= DATE '2025-12-31' ORDER BY dlycaldt

crsp_daily.sql: SELECT permno, permco, dlycaldt, dlyret, dlyretx, dlyretmissflg, dlydelflg, dlyprc, dlyprcflg, dlyclose, dlyopen, dlyhigh, dlylow, dlyvol, dlycap, shrout, dlycumfacpr, dlycumfacshr FROM crsp.dsf_v2 WHERE permno IN (SELECT DISTINCT permno FROM crsp.dsp500list_v2 WHERE mbrenddt >= DATE '1974-01-01') AND dlycaldt BETWEEN DATE '{y}-01-01' AND DATE '{y}-12-31' ORDER BY permno, dlycaldt
